# Phase 2: Credit System - Context

**Gathered:** 2026-01-24
**Status:** Ready for planning

<domain>
## Phase Boundary

Credit tracking and transaction management for dubbing operations. Users have a credit balance, credits are deducted when chapters are dubbed, and transaction history shows all activity. This phase builds the credit infrastructure — purchasing credits is a future phase.

</domain>

<decisions>
## Implementation Decisions

### Credit Pricing Model
- 50 free starter credits for new users (awarded on signup)
- 4 credits for a new chapter extraction (not previously cached)
- 2 credits for a cached chapter (already extracted by another user)
- Pricing is per-chapter, not per-panel — simple and predictable
- Credits are free in v1 (test the flow before adding payments)

### Transaction History
- Full context per transaction: date, credit change, manga title, chapter number, platform, cached vs new indicator, link to source content
- Explicit type labels: "Signup Bonus", "Chapter Read", etc.
- Unified history showing both additions (+50 signup) and deductions (-4 chapter)
- Flat chronological list, newest first
- Pagination (not infinite scroll) — load 20-50 at a time
- 90-day retention window for transaction history
- No export feature needed — view-only in web app
- Links to source content open the chapter on original platform (Webtoon/Tapas/MangaDex)

### Balance Display
- Balance shown on web app account page only (not in extension)
- Real-time updates — balance decrements immediately when chapter is dubbed
- Low balance warning banner when credits drop below 10

### Credit Deduction Flow
- Post-deduct: credits deducted only after successful extraction
- Atomic chapters: check balance before starting, refuse if insufficient (can't run out mid-chapter)
- Cost preview always shown before dubbing: "This chapter: 4 credits (new)" or "2 credits (cached)"
- Insufficient credits: error message with CTA linking to account page

### Claude's Discretion
- Exact pagination page size (20-50 range)
- Warning banner styling and placement
- Real-time update mechanism (WebSocket, polling, etc.)

</decisions>

<specifics>
## Specific Ideas

- Cost preview should clearly distinguish new vs cached so users understand the community benefit of caching
- The "insufficient credits" message should be friendly, not punishing — they get 50 free to start

</specifics>

<deferred>
## Deferred Ideas

None — discussion stayed within phase scope

</deferred>
